_readme: Onboarding template for swift-package projects (lib/project_onboard.py; design in CONTEXT.md 'Per-project execution profiles' and ADR 0036). This is a fragment: apply() merges it onto the skeleton. dispatch is forced OFF and merge_from_dashboard forced FALSE after the merge, regardless of what this template says (hard-coded in apply logic). Check the draft with: ~/.agents/venv/bin/python ~/.agents/lib/project_profile.py selftest <owner/repo> before turning dispatch on.
